note: Extracts a shared _map_arrow_type helper used by both add_pyarrow_schema and add_field, removing the duplicated type mapping rather than calling add_field directly.
Adds products.event_definitions to the products.ai_observability depends_on list in tach.toml, declaring the dependency.
Deletes the purpose-specific repo_selection module; the custom agent base now calls the shared select_repository_for_team, supplying only a request section.
Moves the lenient token parser to a shared aiTokenCount in utils.ts and uses it in both ConversationMessagesDisplay and MetadataHeader.
Adds validated website_domain to AccountProperties, drops the custom-property queries, resolves logo from website_domain then email_domains; no backfill seen.
Replaces the private ModelCost interface with the canonical type import and documents why cache_write_1h_token has no sync pair.
Removes the local _has_legacy_metrics staticmethod and uses experiment_has_legacy_metrics imported from the experiment models module.
Drops the hand-built switch role, aria and key handling on LemonTag; LemonSwitch is now the real control with onChange, label, and disabledReason.
Extracts getGridItemContextMenu to flatten the inline JSX, but the callbacks still use non-null assertions without an inner guard.
Replaces the RepoSelection mirror model with the tasks RepoSelectionResult and drops LineReference; the duplicated choice enums are left unconsolidated.
